svg.aria-label: Proposta A, Índice: símbolo do livro de bolso com a patilha de índice, e a marca Moreira e Vaz
svg.title: Proposta A: Índice
svg.desc: A pocket book drawn in four strokes, three ruled entries inside, and a bottle-green thumb tab on its fore-edge marking the entry that applies. Wordmark in Source Serif 4 semibold.
